visual_language.direction: CS50-style candy lecture stage, deep black field with one saturated candy-colored giant word floating centered per slide (magenta, cyan, yellow, green rotating), monospace syntax-highlighted code blocks, faint stage-spot vignette, minimal text Takahashi method

content_review.reviewer_note: 结构完整（负面约束+密度映射在案）：候选晋升，需 U3 语义审阅补主题绑定与特征后转 active

legacy_payload.best_for: 以深黑舞台、高饱和糖果色大字轮换与一屏一概念的高桥流纪律,做教育课件、技术讲座与代码教学;文字极少,概念即舞台
legacy_payload.visual_direction: CS50-style candy lecture stage, deep black field with one saturated candy-colored giant word floating centered per slide (magenta, cyan, yellow, green rotating), monospace syntax-highlighted code blocks, faint stage-spot vignette, minimal text Takahashi method

canvas.background: 深黑舞台 #0A0A0A(极淡径向暗角聚光感,非粒子光效)
canvas.composition: 一屏一概念:单个糖果色大词居中漂浮,或一个等宽代码块;别无他物
canvas.density: low,文字极少——每页 ≤ 7 词是常态

color_palette.rule: 糖果色每页只上一个(品红/青/明黄 #FFD500/绿 #39FF14 轮换),永不同页混多彩;代码块用语法高亮例外

typography.title: 超粗无衬线大字(Inter Black / 思源黑体 Heavy),居中漂浮,一词一屏
typography.body: 几乎无正文;概念推进入大字而非段落
typography.labels: 代码与术语用等宽(JetBrains Mono),语法高亮上色

layout_patterns: 概念页 = 深黑底 + 单个糖果色大词居中(一词一屏,轮换色)
代码页 = 等宽代码块 + 语法高亮 span 上色,聚焦行加亮
节奏页 = 大词 → 大词 → 代码 → 大词的讲台节拍;强舞台聚光暗角
结论页 = 单句断言,白字或单一糖果色
legacy_payload.layout_usage_rule: 一屏一概念,文字极少:概念拆成大字序列而不是图文混排;糖果色一页一色轮换
negative_prompt: no multi-color word salads — one candy hue per slide, rotating across the deck
no dense bullet lists or paragraphs; concepts go big-word by big-word
no particle light effects or lens flares — just a faint stage vignette
no uniform deep-blue GitHub-dark + neon glow combo (0D1117-style); the stage is neutral black

visual_elements.allowed: 糖果色大字,等宽代码块,语法高亮,舞台暗角,单句断言
visual_elements.avoid: 多色混排;长段落;粒子光效;图表堆砌

rendering_constraints: Deep neutral black stage (not blue-dark); faint radial vignette only.
One candy accent hue per slide, rotating magenta/cyan/yellow/green.
